yum yum!
Dec 2019 • Family
we went there for a quick fix up and the banh mi there was just yum! It was near our hotel, so was quite convenient. the king size option was so good. i would recommend the spicy pork. bulgogi was average. the place is clean, has decent seatings and free WiFi. however, when we visited th3 place again, around 1am ( they are open till 2am), they ran out of bread. so we had to walk out disappointed. all in all, the banh mi served here is clean, healthy and made right in front of your eyes, so it is clean too. good place to go, when you want to eat something light like subway.
